We are looking for a Telecom Solution Engineer to support the design, integration, deployment, and validation of core network solutions in mobile telecom environments. The role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams and customers to deliver successful network implementations.
 Your role:
Design and implement core network elements such as HLR, HSS, AUSF/UDM, SDL, One-NDS, MNP, and EIR.
Perform system integration, deployment, testing, validation, and acceptance activities.
Troubleshoot deployment and call-flow issues, providing timely technical solutions.
Create and maintain technical documentation (LLD, CIQ, DND, ATP, MOP).
Support subscriber data migration and SDM solution integration.
Collaborate with MS, NPI, Care, R&D, and customer teams to ensure project success.
 Your profile:
 Your profile:
Experience with telecom core network technologies (HLR, HSS, SDL, AUSF/UDM, MNP, EIR).
Knowledge of mobile networks (3G/4G/5G) and subscriber data management.
Experience with cloud and virtualization technologies, including Kubernetes, Docker, and VNFs.
Proficiency in Unix/Linux and basic scripting (Shell, Python, Perl, Ansible).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent teamwork, customer-focus, and advanced English communication skills.
